me.intrestes: I enjoy learning new topics in technology and science, especially physics and astronomy. Outside of development, I like gaming, movies, and TV shows, which keeps me curious about design, systems, and how people interact with digital experiences.
me.merit: I am Alex, a developer based in Stockholm with experience in JavaScript and modern tools like Vite. I enjoy building projects from scratch and working across both frontend and backend. I have worked with backend concepts such as middleware and database design, and I have used both SQL databases like MySQL and NoSQL databases like MongoDB. I am especially interested in how good structure and architecture impact real-world applications. I also have practical experience from internships at two companies, where I wrote code, designed high-level design documents, and created database relationship diagrams. I enjoy MongoDB for its flexibility when designing data models, and I am also strong at analyzing and breaking down website structures and design systems. I am looking to contribute to a real team, continue improving, and work on larger projects where I can grow and add value.
